Use a known point on the graph such as $(0, -1)$ or $(\pi/2, 3)$ to solve for the vertical stretch factor $a$.
walkthrough:
Identify the point of inflection (centre of symmetry) of the tangent wave from the diagram at $\left(\frac{\pi}{4}, 1\right)$:
$$b = \frac{\pi}{4}, \quad c = 1$$

Use the $y$-intercept at $(0, -1)$ to determine the vertical stretch factor $a$:
$$-1 = a\tan\left(0 - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + 1 = a\tan\left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right) + 1 = -a + 1 \implies a = 2$$

State the three constants:
$$a = 2, \quad b = \frac{\pi}{4}, \quad c = 1$$
